title: GPU utilization on this run's nodes
description: Mean busy percentage across the GPUs on nodes attributed to this run. Long steps with low busy percentage suggest devices are waiting; compare with driver wall and generation waits. Attribution assigns an entire node bucket to the run with the most observations; requires node-agent reporting. Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers. GPU detail is available for ranges of 7h or less; longer ranges show a zoom message.

defaults.noValue: No GPU data. Over 7h: zoom to 7h or less. Otherwise no node join: trainer rows carry no node_name, or the node agent is not reporting this cluster. This is never “GPUs idle”.
